name: imap-plugin
description: Hosted MCP plugin for generic IMAP mailboxes with read tools and paid mail actions.

interface.shortDescription: Read IMAP mailboxes and enable paid mail actions from Codex or compatible GPTs.
interface.longDescription: Hosted MCP plugin for connecting generic IMAP mailboxes to Codex and compatible GPTs through a public MCP endpoint. It supports folder listing, message search, message reading, attachment access, and subscriber-controlled SMTP/IMAP mail actions without requiring a provider-specific mail connector. It is not a background mailbox sync service. Non-OpenAI assistant use is outside the project scope and is at the user's own risk.
defaultPrompt: Enable SMTP sending for IMAP Mailboxes.
